articles.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
articles.summary: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory. US President Donald Trump signed the deal alongside Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen The US, Denmark and Greenland have signed a defence deal that allows Washington to build two new military bases in the Arctic territory, while reaffirming Copenhagen's sovereignty over it. Before a signing ceremony at the UN General Assembly in New York, US President Donald T
articles.why: USA, Danmark og Grønland har underskrevet en forsvarsaftale, der tillader Washington at etablere to nye militærbaser i Grønland og genbekræfter dansk suverænitet. Det ændrer direkte dansk-arktisk sikkerhedsdagsorden og har konsekvenser for Forsvaret, politik og grønlandsk debat — vigtige punkter for Mads.

articles.title: Sam Altman kalder hændelsen ”frygtindgydende”. Har han ret?
articles.summary: Ikke alle køber dommedagsfortællingen. Her er historien bag Hugging Face-hændelsen. Ikke alle køber dommedagsfortællingen. Her er historien bag Hugging Face-hændelsen. OpenAI's Sam Altman er kommet i søgelyset. Kunne han have forhindret, at hans AI-modeller brød ind i en anden virksomhed? Foto: Grafik: Göran Blomquist, TV 2 / Ritzau Scanpix
articles.why: Dansk gennemgang af Hugging Face-hændelsen, med fokus på om OpenAI-ledelsen kunne forhindret modellen i at ‘brække ind’ i en anden virksomhed. Vigtig for at følge ansvar, governance og konsekvenser for AI-udvikling, som berører danske regulatoriske og erhvervspolitiske diskussioner.

articles.summary: The frontier AI model race has entered its comparison shopping phase. The frontier AI model race has entered its comparison shopping phase. OpenAI and Anthropic both recently released new models aimed at lowering costs. Anthropic announced Opus 5.5, the latest version of its main mass-market workhorse model, used for tasks like coding and other complex knowledge work. And OpenAI announced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, the latest versions of its middle-of-the-road or smaller models focused on efficiency an
articles.why: Sammenligning af nyeste modeller fra Anthropic og OpenAI, der lover lavere omkostninger for højere kapacitet — central viden for Mads når AI-økonomi og modelvalg begynder at forme danske virksomheder, medier og startups.

Microsoft said Tuesday that it led an industry-wide disruption of a subscription-based scam platform that used an AI chatbot to compromise 12,000 Microsoft accounts over a few-month span. Named EvilTokens, the platform was introduced over a Telegram channel in February and charged an initial $1,500 fee and a recurring
articles.why: Microsoft ledede en operation mod 'EvilTokens', en AI-drevet platform, som kompromitterede 12.000 Microsoft-konti. Historien viser hvordan AI muliggør masseangreb — relevant for danske it-sikkerhedsafdelinger og beslutningstagere.

articles.title: Don’t be fooled by this summer of AI hype
articles.summary: It’s been a busy few months for AI hype. At the end of April, Anthropic claimed that its model Claude Mythos is better at finding software vulnerabilities than most security experts. Then we had the OpenAI–Hugging Face hacking incident, after which Anthropic (proudly) and Meta (reluctantly) disclosed similar incidents involving their models. This was followed…
articles.why: Nuanceret, kritisk gennemgang af sommerens AI-hype, inkl. modelpåstande og hændelser som OpenAI–Hugging Face — hjælper Mads adskille markedsføring fra reelle tekniske og sikkerhedsmæssige skift.

articles.title: Three Ts will dominate Trump-Xi summit – but expect little movement on trade, less on Taiwan and who knows on tech
articles.summary: Chinese and American leaders meet amid growing urgency over the issue of AI regulation. Share article Print article When Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping
articles.why: Lang analyse af Trump–Xi-topmødet med fokus på trade, Taiwan og teknologi (særligt AI). Relevant for Europa/Danmark: udfald kan ændre globale forsyningskæder, tech-regulering og strategiske alliancer.

articles.title: Big tech says AI can find a cure for cancer. So where is it?
articles.summary: Alongside warnings about its ability to destroy humanity, artificial intelligence is also hailed for its potential to revolutionise health treatment. Just how far can it take us?Her name was June. June would be the last month she ever knew.I remember the way her bed made her so small, swallowed her up in the middle of the room, turned as it was to face the window. With her liver failing, her skin was a ghostly apricot. June – I called her Nan – had been stalked by the king of terrors, the empero
articles.why: Store, kritiske gennemgang af hvilke konkrete fremskridt (og begrænsninger) AI har leveret i medicinsk forskning. Mads får evidensbaseret perspektiv på »AI-løfter« indenfor sundhed — vigtigt for forsknings- og sundhedspolitik-debatten i Danmark.

articles.title: Lyner det på fjerne planeter? Dansk forskning peger på masser af bulder og brag
articles.summary: Planeten K2-18b er berømt for fund af mulige tegn på liv. Nu tyder ny forskning på, at den famøse planet er fyldt med voldsomt vejr. \ Automatisk oplæsning
articles.why: Dansk-relateret forskning om voldsomt vejr på exoplaneten K2-18b; både nyskabende og nationale forskningsresultater, interessant for Mads som oplysning om dansk forskningsprofil i rumforskning.

articles.why: Interview/portræt med finansminister Peter Hummelgaard om behovet for større økonomisk indsats for at genskabe balance i Danmark. Relevant for økonomisk politik, budgetprioriteringer og Mads' forståelse af regeringens ambitioner.

articles.title: Kultur er nedtonet i regeringsgrundlaget
articles.summary: Filmmagasinet Ekko er et magasin om film og medier. Det er anmeldelser, essays, analyser og baggrund, store interviews med hjemlige såvel som internationale filmikoner – skrevet af danske og internationale kritikere, filmfolk, journalister og kulturpersonligheder.

To get the new betas, you can sign up on Apple's beta testing website. After you're signed up, the betas can be installed through the Software Update section in the Settings app on each device.

articles.why: Apple udruller offentlige betaversioner af iOS 27.2 og macOS 27.2 — vigtigt for danske brugere, udviklere og organisationer der planlægger opdateringsvinduer, kompatibilitet og nye funktioner.

articles.title: Lula’s UN address points to two starkly different visions of Brazilian nationalism ahead of crucial election
articles.summary: The race between the incumbent president and Flávio Bolsonaro is a part of a decades-long right-left split in the country over the meaning of the nation. Share article Print article When Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva addressed the United Nations General Assembly on Sept. 22, 2026, the Brazilian president posed a question to both an international and domestic audience: Who is to decide Brazil’s future?
articles.why: Lang analyse af Lulas FN-tale og de to idéer om brasiliansk nationalisme foran et væsentligt valg — nyttig geopolitisk læsning, når valg i store lande påvirker globale alliancer og råvare-/handelsdynamikker.

articles.title: Forgotten Mozart notebook reveals how a young woman learned to compose
articles.summary: The notebook preserves something that composer-centred histories often miss: the musical work taking place around Mozart, in this case by a young woman.
articles.why: Interessant musikhistorisk fund: en glemt Mozarts-notesbog belyst hvordan unge kvinder lærte komposition — en velresearcheret kultur- og kønshistorisk vinkel, god som dybdelæsning for Mads.
